title: Remediate archive extraction path traversal in FUNSD sample downloader

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Replaced direct ZipFile.extractall usage with guarded extraction that validates every zip member resolves under destination before extraction; this blocks path traversal (zip slip) writes outside temp_dir.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Closing on evidence: PR 44 (feature/blbs-6415ba-funsd-zip-slip-fix, fix commit 7ab7172) merged 2026-05-05. scripts/download_funsd_samples.py on develop extracts through _extract_zip_safely, which rejects absolute paths, '..' parts, and any member that resolves outside the destination. No ZipFile.extractall remains in src, scripts or tools. The issue stayed in_progress after that merge because nobody closed it.
